title: Robust Git state inspection and guarded repository actions
summary: Repository-state parsing and freshness-aware comparisons provide reliable engineering context before destructive state changes.

dates.note: Exact start/end dates are not documented. Technical mechanisms are reported in the October 5, 2026 snapshot; any later owner clarifications are cited per fact.

facts.text: Implemented Git porcelain-v2 parsing for staged/unstaged/untracked files, renames, conflicts, Unicode paths and detached HEADs.
Followed configured upstreams and distinguished fresh, cached and missing remote-comparison evidence in repository inspection.
Rechecked branch identity, cleanliness, remote availability and ahead counts after fetching before reset-to-origin actions.
